competing_explanation: A wider generator read may blur mode resolution under BCAP's saturated slope, trading acquisition for density/hold quality.
hypothesis: Closed PR #107 'stall reach': the generator reads the critic through a 2d+1 axis stencil whose width widens with the critic's measured input slope (max(.15, .5 min(u, 1/u))/kappa) and jumps to .5/kappa after 50 consecutive saturated (u >= .6) critic updates. Widening the generator's critic read when acquisition stalls lets particles see the missing mode. On the PR84 line it gave warm 200/200 and cold ring 8; here it should convert mode_hold FAIL (suffix 3) to a sustained PASS (suffix >= 5) under the unchanged BCAP direction-blend leader.
